topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: When I heard that my best friend is moving across the country, I knew I had to be the rock. We’ve been through so much together, and this news felt like a punch, but I can handle it. I told them, “This is a big step, and you’re ready for it. I’m here for you, every mile of the way.” I even started helping with the move, finding tips for long-distance friendships, and making a plan to visit. I might be feeling a bit wistful, but mostly, I’m focused on how we can make this work. Because that’s what friends do—they face the challenges together, no matter the distance.
